verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.stripe.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and contains agent-directed instructions. A second probe shows the Invoicing docs are served as clean markdown (.md) pages, which an agent can ingest directly, and the cited doc pages themselves are .md URLs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of agents successfully using these docs in practice, and any detail on the llms.txt's coverage of Invoicing specifically.
